items.question: What is the name of the federal UAE platform that integrates government data on economic licences, and which segments does it serve?
items.gold: The National Economic Registry (NER) serves government entities, businessmen, researchers and investors.
items.fact: NER serves government entities, businessmen, researchers, and investors

items.question: What three things can a user enquire about through the UAE National Economic Registry (NER)?
items.gold: Economic licenses, economic activity, and availability of trade names.
items.fact: NER enquiries cover licenses, economic activity, trade name availability
